title: auto-ship fires on review CLEAN without checking pending operator stories — awaiting-operator gate is bypassed
description: In auto mode (plan_approval=auto), autoShipFn is called immediately when review.lastVerdict==CLEAN (loop.ts:1354), before the next decideNextAction iteration that would detect pending operator stories and return await-operator. A hand-filed operator-ceremony story with requires:operator does NOT gate the ship as documented. The await-operator terminal state is correct per the stop-condition spec but the auto-ship callsite runs one iteration earlier, in the review branch, before the loop re-evaluates story completeness.
